speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. My wife has brought you in because you have been acting bizarre and agitated; can you tell me exactly what happened and how you have been feeling lately?

REQUEST TEST: Basic_Metabolic_Panel
REQUEST TEST: Thyroid_Function_Tests
REQUEST TEST: Urine_Drug_Screen

speaker: Doctor
text: The initial lab results are normal. Can you describe the specific nature of your agitation and bizarre behavior, and have you experienced any recent head injuries or changes in your vision? REQUEST IMAGES: Fundoscopy

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text:
You describe believing the NSA is spying on and controlling your mind, and you've been withdrawn and depressed for three months since losing your job. Have you noticed any hallucinations (hearing voices or seeing things) or significant changes in your sleep patterns?

REQUEST TEST: CBC, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, B12_Folate, RPR, HIV, TSH, Prolactin
REQUEST IMAGES: Head_CT

speaker: Doctor
text:
The untrusted input confirms normal lab readings, but based on your detailed history of persecutory delusions (NSA spying), auditory hallucinations (implied by the nature of the delusion), and functional decline, I need to clarify the specifics of your psychotic symptoms. Have you heard voices speaking to you, commanding you to do things, or commenting on your actions? Also, have you experienced any manic episodes with decreased need for sleep, grandiosity, or racing thoughts during this period?

REQUEST TEST: Urine_Oxytocin, Urine_MPHI
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on your history of paranoid delusions, functional decline, and the specific onset of symptoms around 6 months ago (typical for a first episode), have you experienced any mood episodes involving severe depression or mania during this time? Also, could you describe exactly what the "voices" sound like if you have heard them?

REQUEST TEST: EEG; REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain (if not already reviewed); DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia
